messages:
Priya Patel: Sharing a new compact pool card mock for the autoscale panel. Goal: show min/max, burst toggle, selected GPU pool, and an SLO "rail" without eating vertical space. Fig: https://redwood-internal.screenshots/2335007890/compact-pool-card.png
Alex Chen: Nice direction. Immediate thought: the SLO rail as a thin horizontal bar feels visual-only. We should show the numeric SLO target (ms) for screen readers and hover.
Maya Rivera: Visual note 12: the min/max numbers are competing with the pool name. Propose stacking min/max vertically and shrinking pool name to a single line with ellipsis.
Jordan Lee: Implementation caveat 12: stacked numbers increase height. If we keep single-line height we need micro-layout: left area = pool + chevron, center = min/max stacked, right = SLO rail + burst. Could work.
Samir Gupta: Can we make default min=1 for dedicated pools? Also question: when burst is enabled, do we show estimated burst cost or just a tooltip? We should avoid surprise billing.
Priya Patel: Agree on cost transparency. Proposal: tiny cost chip appears on hover of burst pill: "~$0.XX/min while active" and link to billing docs.
Maya Rivera: Copy tweak: change label from "SLO" to "Latency target" on the card, keep "SLO" in the details tooltip. Less jargon for new users.
A11yBot: Scanner result: SLO rail color contrast against the card background = 3.1:1. Fails AA. Recommend adjusting to 4.5:1 or providing a patterned fill. Also ensure rail has aria-valuenow and aria-label.
Alex Chen: Keyboard flow: pool chevron must be reachable via Tab, and arrow keys should navigate the pool list. SLO slider should respond to Left/Right by 10ms steps; Home/End to min/max. We'll show numeric value in a visible label when focused.
Jordan Lee: Perf ask from Eng: can we lazy-render the SLO micrograph and burst cost chip only when the card is visible? For dashboards with 80+ cards, that should help frame drops.
Samir Gupta: UX edgecase: what happens if user sets min > max by keyboard increments? Validate in component and show inline error: "Min cannot exceed Max" with role="alert" for screen readers.
Maya Rivera: Microcopy for burst tooltip draft: "Burst provides temporary extra GPUs to handle traffic spikes. Billed separately; duration limited by pool settings." Shorten further if needed.
Priya Patel: Decision items: 1) default min=1 for Dedicated. 2) show latency target numeric label. 3) show burst cost on hover. 4) collapsed pool label for single-pool accounts. Anyone object?
Alex Chen: No objections. I'll update the Figma with stacked min/max variant and a collapsed-pool state.
Jordan Lee: I'll run a render perf check on staging with 100 cards and post results here (paint times + mem). ETA ~2h.
A11yBot: Suggest adding focus ring CSS and ensure color tokens are mapped to high-contrast theme. Example: `--focus-ring: 3px solid #FFB84D;`
Priya Patel: Thanks all. Maya, please post the next mock with darker SLO rail and the compact cost tooltip. We'll do a quick sync tomorrow if the perf numbers look good.
